response.sql: WITH benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS net_rate FROM fees), order_averages AS (SELECT orderslink, AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_rebate, AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS avg_net_rate FROM fees GROUP BY orderslink) SELECT AVG(o.avg_rebate) AS avg_total_rebate, AVG(o.avg_net_rate) AS avg_net_fee_rate, AVG(o.avg_net_rate - b.net_rate) AS avg_excess_net_fee_rate FROM order_averages AS o CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE o.avg_net_rate > b.net_rate
